title: Lush’s heart grows three sizes with The Grinch Christmas collaboration
summary: The Lush × The Grinch 2026 Christmas collaboration has been formulated with a sour but sweet green apple fragrance as the British beauty retailer continues to build on its licensed brand collaboration success
